Manage the Squad dashboard for this directory with one Bash call, then reply with one line. The command's argument is `$0`.

- If the argument is exactly `stop`, run `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/squad" dashboard stop`.
- If the argument is exactly `status`, run `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/squad" dashboard status`.
- Otherwise (no argument, or any other word), run `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/squad" dashboard --detach --open`. It starts the dashboard in the background, or finds the one already running, and opens it in the browser.

Run one of these three commands exactly as written; never add to them. Reply with the URL it printed (it serves on 127.0.0.1 only), or say it stopped.
